title: Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.14790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. However, existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves establish when local reflection yields long-term performance guarantees for the complete agent under resource constraints. In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. translated_title: 具有Lean验证保证的反思型智能体反事实遗憾
translated_abstract: 反思型语言智能体通过复用反馈和记忆来跨任务进行适应，而无需更新模型权重。然而，现有的策略选择和动作生成保证本身并不能确定在资源约束下，局部反思何时能为完整智能体带来长期性能保证。在本文中，我们通过从局部生成和部署保证推导出次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件来填补这一空白，同时保留原生控制器。具体而言，我们建立了一种资源敏感的迁移机制，该机制沿实际执行路径约束全状态部署差异，并保留学习者与比较者的自身历史规律。此外，局部生成可靠性产生了累积生成机会上界，通过明确的质量、覆盖率与硬预算之间的权衡，将策略获取与长期性能联系起来。为了验证这些保证，我们……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文从局部生成与部署保证出发，为反思型语言智能体推导出次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并通过资源敏感的迁移机制和累积生成机会上界将局部反思与长期性能联系起来，同时用Lean进行形式化验证。
en_tdlr: The paper derives sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret in reflective language agents from local generation and deployment guarantees, linking local reflection to long-term performance via resource-sensitive transfer and cumulative generation opportunity bounds, with formal verification in Lean.
